evidence: Wallet label and changes to src/external_signer.cpp and external signer functional test suite.
rationale: Hardens external signer PSBT processing against transaction mutation and fund theft. Bitcoin Core previously replaced outgoing PSBTs wholesale with the signer's response, trusting external hardware or bridge software not to alter outputs or use sighash flags like SIGHASH_NONE or SIGHASH_SINGLE that let third parties redirect funds post-signing.
